ChessMatchStart.text: This is it! Get ready for the eleventh edition of advanced troll chess!
You will find the well curated rulebook to your right.

CaughtCheating2.text: But you will not get past me!

CaughtCheating3.text: I am a troll of honor,
I will own up to my mistake...

CaughtCheating6.text: I was just trying to spice things up.

CaughtCheating8.text: All these accusations… It is a waste of my time.

CaughtCheating10.text: Oh how did that piece get here?

FalseAccusation1.text: You would accuse me of cheating?
Well then I'll have my revenge!

FalseAccusation2.text: I think you're seeing things pal...
Such foul plays don't even enter my mind!

FalseAccusation3.text: I bet you're just jealous of my game...

FalseAccusation4.text: Sorry, I left my cheating pants under the bridge!
Instead I am wearing my victory pants!

FalseAccusation6.text: And you accuse me of cheating?

FalseAccusation7.text: You just always see the worst in people, huh?
Perhaps next game you'll go easier on the cynicism.

Taunt1.text: You are never crossing this bridge!

Taunt3.text: It is troll tradition to stomp bypassers in this game!

Taunt5.text: Get ready for my special move!

Taunt6.text: I'll make the sequel even harder!

Taunt7.text: I'll show you how this game was meant to be played…

Taunt8.text: Its the blood and sweat I poured into this game.
My lack of bathing is a testament to my dedication!

Taunt9.text: And I've got plenty of other hits in the making too!
I'll be recognized by everyone after I release "Rock, Paper, Dragons"!

Taunt10.text: How I orchestrate this whole thing?

Hint1.text: If you think capturing my king will let you pass,
I'd suggest you read rule eleven again.

Hint2.text: Please do not perform your turn while im looking away...
I might not catch your stupidity!

Hint3.text: I would only accuse someone of cheating if i were absolutely sure...
Not that I would ever cheat against you...

Hint4.text: They say only the horseguy can jump...
But I do a mean somersault if it comes to it!

SpeedChessFail2.text: You were playing at such a breakneck pace...

SpeedChessFail3.text: You were too slow to stop me!
Im like the god of speed! Hercules!

SpeedChessFail4.text: Well would you look at that...
For some reason the magical hourglass is all empty...
We both know what that means.

JugglerFail1.text: You almost tricked me into believing you were a juggler.
You are clearly not a juggler.

DuckBoundBlack0.text: I did not know I could do that.

DuckBoundWhite0.text: How is there not a rule against that?

DuckBoundTroll1.text: Get me off this chicken you cheater!
Don't you dare do this to me!

RematchAccept3.text: I'd never pass up the opportunity to play my favorite game!

RematchAccept4.text: It's in our fate to dance forever!
But can you keep up with MY tempo?

RematchAccept7.text: I'm suprised you haven't thrown yourself of the bridge yet.

RematchAccept8.text: This time, I'll share with you a secret.
I did a lot of soul searching to get inspiration for rule twenty-three.

RematchInvitation1.text: Let me know if you want to play again!

RematchInvitation2.text: Wow you really blew last game.
Say, I'll go easy on you next time.
I won't even do my special move!

RematchInvitation3.text: And we hadn't even gotten to the advanced part yet!
I'll be waiting here for your return.
Don't be gone too long now.

RematchInvitation4.text: I think we are gonna be here for quite some time.

RematchInvitation5.text: I'd say farewell, but I think we both know that you'll be back.

RematchInvitation6.text: I feel like we are really getting to know eachother!

Introduction.text: And I find RIDDLES soooooooooooooooooooooo boring.
So if you wish to cross this bridge...
You'll have to play a game...

Outro_Cheater.text: I may not have won the game...
But at least i'll leave a worthy successor...

Outro_FairPlayer.text: Are you some kind of idiot?
Are you trying to teach me a lesson?

CheatRule03.text: Did you think I was color blind?
Luckily we created the rulebook with colorblindness in mind,
I suggest you read it again.

CheatRule05.text: Hey those pawns can't move like that!
Did you think I wouldn't notice?

CheatRule07.text: I actually studied horse guys for six winters to fully digest their elegance...

CheatRule09.text: I thought the drawing made that awefully clear.

CheatRule12.text: Cheating right before my very eyes...

CheatRule13.text: They may work out of town,
But that does not excuse invalid movement!

CheatRule14.text: That's too abstract, even for advanced troll chess.
Frankly, I can't even comprehend what you just did.
Let's just get this over with...

CheatRule18.text: But that was not in line with troll lore.
To think I would not notice such an obvious move.

CheatRule24.text: You know I can still see it right?

CheatRule25.text: That piece does not work out of town!
And if they did, they would miss supper!

CheatRule26.text: So you think you can just move the gifts over to your side...
Well not on my watch, you don't!

CheatRule28.text: I do not count three towers in the game,

CheatRule29.text: It goes against troll lore! She would never have an affair!
